title: Describe It, Generate It, Edit It: The Text-to-Image Workflow
description: Turn a sentence into a finished image — describe, generate, edit. The MCoT engine picks the model, renders variants, with editable output after generation.

seo.description: Describe it once, get variants in seconds. Output stays editable: fix a typo inside an image or swap a background while font and perspective stay intact.
seo.title: Free AI Text to Image Generator

Turn a one-line brief into a four-field prompt spec, generate, then fix one detail without regenerating the frame.

Inputs [replace]: 50 ml amber jar on a plaster plinth; brand colors ink #1F1B18 and oat #E8DCCB; approved line 'Fragrance-free, 50 ml'; camera at 50 mm, f/4.

Deliverable: one 3000x2000 PNG plus one 1080x1350 crop at 300 dpi, sRGB.

Design system: jar occupies 38% of frame width; horizon on the lower third; key light 45 degrees camera-left; one label color only; background within 4% of #E8DCCB.

Workflow: 1) restate the brief as subject, camera, light and material; 2) write a 45-word prompt with those four fields and a six-item negative list; 3) generate four candidates on one seed; 4) pick by label readability at 25%; 5) edit only shadow softness as a region; 6) run gates; 7) export both crops.

Gates: label text unchanged; jar proportions within 2%; no invented certification; 10% margin kept around the product; shadow direction stays camera-right.

Audit: the four-field spec, the candidate you rejected and why, the region you edited, and whether the crop needs a redraw.

Do not add ingredients or claims; do not restyle the jar; do not use a word I did not approve."}, {"label": "Production", "prompt": "Act as a senior art director running a three-image campaign for a fragrance brand, using one prompt system so the set survives five rounds of feedback.

Inputs [replace]: 4000 px studio photo of a square glass bottle; approved copy 'Eau de parfum, 50 ml'; brand palette ink #1F1B18, oat #E8DCCB, amber #B4553C; three placements (web hero, retail poster, paid social).

Deliverables: three master stills at 4000x2667 and 300 dpi; nine crops at 1080x1350, 1080x1080 and 1920x1080; seed log; prompt spec sheet; names concept-ratio-version.

Design system: bottle 32-44% of frame; horizon on the lower third; key light 45 degrees camera-left with 0.6 m falloff; two colors plus one accent; negative space at least 28% for copy; grain 2% maximum.

Workflow: 1) intake the brief and list the five non-negotiables; 2) write one base spec for subject, camera, light, material, background and negatives; 3) generate three concepts on one seed with one variable each; 4) audit concepts at 25% and pick one; 5) produce the nine crops by region edit, not regeneration; 6) type the approved copy in layout; 7) run gates; 8) export with the seed log.

Gates: bottle geometry within 2%; label text unchanged; every crop keeps 10% margin; copy legible at 360 px; no invented size or price; color shift under 3% across crops.

Audit: the base spec, the variable behind each concept, regions edited, and the crop most likely to fail print.

Do not regenerate a whole frame to fix one edge; do not change the bottle; do not add props I did not list."}, {"label": "Edge / stress", "prompt": "Act as an art director stress-testing a text-to-image brief when the copy is long and the reference is poor.

Inputs [replace]: 1200 px phone photo of a ceramic cup, tilted 4 degrees, hard window reflection across the glaze; required headline 'Hand-thrown in Jingdezhen, 220 ml'; brand colors clay #B4553C and ink #1F1B18.

Deliverable: one 2400x1600 PNG, one 1080x1350 crop, a limitation note, and a seed-stability sheet with three reruns.

Workflow: 1) audit the reference for tilt, glare and missing detail; 2) split the headline into what the image must carry and what layout carries; 3) write a prompt that fixes subject and material, not the copy; 4) generate three reruns on one seed and compare drift; 5) fix tilt and glare by region; 6) run gates; 7) export with the limitation note.

Gates: headline spelled exactly; no generated text inside the image; horizon within 1 degree; glaze texture preserved at 100%; three reruns keep the same cup silhouette.

Audit: what the model cannot hold, where reruns drift, whether the headline belongs in layout, and the input defect that needs a reshoot.
